claim: Patchline ships an agent liveness guarantee proving every accepted task eventually merges or escalates. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the liveness guarantee claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make agent-liveness-guarantee-gate`.
